title: LEGACY Key Collation — Strategy
subtitle: Projectname domains DB · 2026-07-01 · Feature 3049

decision.label: Decision
decision.body: Rebuild + Centralize. Rebuild the database so text is case-sensitive by default (a Binary-Default (BIN2) Store), and handle case-insensitive search in one place (a Centralized Search Layer). Build the layer first, flip the store second.

lines: State — dev works (shipped fix + gate), but fragile

goal.label: Goal
goal.name: Rebuild + Centralize
lines: State — errors impossible; search handled once

diagrams.caption: Safe path: build the layer first, then flip the store.

one_rule: Build the search layer before flipping the store. Flip first and ~194 searches silently turn case-sensitive — the Centralized Search Layer is the safety net that makes the flip safe.

plan.title: Bridge (now).
plan.body: Keep Patch-and-Guard live — the shipped fix + Collation Gate keep dev working through the rebuild.

plan.title: Build the Centralized Search Layer
plan.body: in apps/api. Route all search / filter / sort through it. The big step.
